:::{#def-test-set}
#### Test set

The **test set** of a [training/validation/test split](#def-data-splits)
is the [held-out set](#def-held-out-set) of observations indexed by $I_{\text{test}}$,
on which the rule of the [validation choice](#def-validation-choice) $g_{\est{l}}$ is scored:

$$
\paren{(x_i, y_i)}_{i \in I_{\text{test}}}.
$$ {#eq-test-set}

:::
